includedDelta.purpose: Render active and future departments in one untitled field.
Typed ACTIVE/FUTURE root model with only Hotels and Events as future top-level departments.
Focused active-link, future-inertness and prohibited-copy regression coverage.
Narrow presentation authority and explicit non-route boundary.

excludedDirtyChanges.policy: Every checkout change outside includedDelta is excluded from this candidate.

blocker: The provider confirms the baseline deployment but does not expose its source through the safe CLI surface. The checkout acquired unrelated deployable changes after baseline creation, so a byte-faithful isolated build cannot be materialized without a trusted baseline source export.
